headline.description: One line: the main reason for the rating. The page shows the rating itself above it, so the line does not repeat it.

summary.description: Markdown, two to four sentences: what this bump is, in max's terms.

held_because.description: Markdown, for a held bump only: what would have to be true to apply it, and what to check after.

changes.description: Every change worth a line, most important first. Routine version bumps may be grouped into one entry.

from.description: The old version or revision; empty when the package is new.

to.description: The new version or revision; empty when the package went.

detail.description: Markdown, one to three sentences: what it means for max's machines.

source.description: A URL: changelog, release notes, advisory or nixpkgs commit.

closure.description: The closure's size change, as nvd states it.

notes.description: Markdown: anything else worth knowing, such as a warning the update printed.
